content.comment_body: Has anyone developed a PC application to control or trigger inputs on a [product_name] PLC?

Hello, The simplest approach would be to use [product_name] Advanced Runtime, as it includes a driver for [product_name]. If you prefer a custom solution, OPC could be used for communication. Direct control of PLC inputs from software is not possible since inputs are physical. However, you can trigger the V memory area instead. Best regards, [user_name]
Hello, It is not possible to control physical inputs via a PC application.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for a way to programmatically control [company_name] [product_name] hardware from a PC, specifically to send commands or manipulate I/O. Responses clarify that direct control of physical inputs from software is not feasible, but interaction is possible with internal memory areas (like V memory) using PC applications such as [product_name] or through OPC communication. The main limitation highlighted is the inability to remotely simulate or control hardware inputs through software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users wish to remotely trigger or manipulate PLC inputs from a PC application, aiming for comprehensive I/O simulation and control of [product_name].
